# Psalm 148 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him from the highest places!

**2** Praise him, every angel! Praise him, all his heavenly armies!

**3** Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, every shining star!

**4** Praise him, highest heavens, and the waters above the sky!

**5** Let them all praise the LORD's name — because he gave the command and they were created.

**6** He established them forever — he issued a decree that will never be revoked.

**7** Praise the LORD from the earth — sea monsters and ocean depths!

**8** Lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful winds that carry out his orders!

**9** Mountains and every hill, fruit trees and every cedar!

**10** Wild animals and every herd, insects and every bird!

**11** Kings of the earth and every nation, rulers and every judge on earth!

**12** Young men and young women, elderly and children!

**13** Let them all praise the LORD's name! His name alone is supreme; his splendor rises above the earth and sky.

**14** He has given his people renewed strength — earning praise from all his faithful ones, from the people of Israel who are close to his heart. Hallelujah!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **148:1-14**: The ultimate roll call of praise: angels, stars, sea monsters, weather, mountains, trees, animals, kings, nations, young and old. Nobody and nothing gets to sit this one out. The whole universe is a choir.

— PNEUMA
